card.name: Nouns right before a relative clause
card.fires_on: Singular or plural nouns such as provision, subject, patient, effect, mission or project that follow a number, a determiner or a modifier and are followed by a clause or a verb. It also fires on the ends of longer words like decrements and substrates.
